definition: Problems with battery life health draining overheating or unexpected battery behavior
include: battery drains quickly; battery percentage drops unusually; overheating related to battery
exclude: charging the device; general performance problems

definition: Problems installing completing or functioning correctly after an iOS/iPadOS update
include: update failed; update stuck; bugs explicitly attributed to update
exclude: battery problems after update unless battery is the primary complaint

definition: Device or apps become slow frozen unresponsive or crash
include: freezing; lag; apps crashing; general slowness

definition: Device unexpectedly restarts or has trouble starting
include: random restarts; boot loops; phone won't start

definition: Problems charging the device or with charging accessories
include: won't charge; accessory not supported; charging connection

definition: Problems hearing or producing sound during calls or general audio use
include: can't hear callers; microphone; ringtone; speaker; audio output

definition: Problems with screen display touch input or keyboard interaction
include: screen issues; touch not responding; keyboard problems; display glitches
exclude: app-specific problems when screen itself works

definition: Problems connecting through Wi-Fi cellular Bluetooth or similar connections
Problems with Apple ID iCloud account access or device/account lockout
include: Apple ID; iCloud; locked account; account access
exclude: device passcode issues without account context

definition: Problems involving apps music podcasts or other media services
include: apps; Apple Music; Podcasts; media behavior

definition: Questions or problems involving Apple purchases orders reservations or store support
Questions about how a feature works or whether something is possible
include: Can I; How do I; where is setting; feature availability

definition: Messages that do not contain enough information or do not fit another category
include: vague requests; unsupported topics; unclear intent
exclude: messages that clearly fit another intent
